title: Maui MPO 2045 long-range transportation plan
summary: With the long-range transportation plan expiring at the end of 2024, the MPO approved a full 2045 update instead of reaffirming the 2040 plan, because the earlier plan predated community engagement on rebuilding West Maui. Until a new plan is adopted the funded project list cannot be changed, and the plan is meant to adopt all transportation projects in the West Maui recovery plan.
